ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels; the visible ventral surface is approximately 98% low-intensity black/dark grey.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly solid low-intensity pigmentation across both lobes; high-contrast white focal clusters (rosettes) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes; a faint mid-intensity grey gradient is visible at the junction of the lobes near the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep bounding-box penetration; calculated interior angle is approximately 60-70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge displays irregular, low-amplitude serrations; the right lobe trailing edge contains a distinct macroscopic notch/indentation located approximately two-thirds of the distance from the median notch toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges leading into the median notch; outer edges exhibit a sharp, tapered convex sweep ending in acuminate tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters (white on black) are densely aggregated at the terminal points of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of distinct, unaligned light-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks/scratches) are visible, primarily oriented vertically and diagonally across the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear abrasions on the left lobe and significant high-contrast scarring/encrustation at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The fluke tips are exceptionally sharp and pointed compared to standard morphology; a deep, narrow median notch that maintains sharp pixel definition at the base.
